caveats: DISCONTINUED: Ploomber retired its app-hosting platform (Ploomber Cloud) on 2025-10-31 (official blog post 'Ploomber's app hosting platform is shutting down', Sep 09 2025, via Wayback). Deploys stopped 2025-10-03, all running apps shut down 2025-10-31. ploomber.io now has no A records (Namecheap zone, SOA serial = 2026-05-07; domain registered until 2027-01-25); the last Wayback captures of the site are 2026-04-21/22. YC lists the company as Inactive. Not a priceable provider.
Inventory exclusion: inactive / DNS unavailable. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.tiers: Historical only (retired 2025-10-31): Community 2 simultaneous apps; Professional 10; Teams 20; Enterprise unlimited.
fleet.notes: Concurrent apps on Ploomber Cloud, not notebook historical quotas or arbitrary VMs. Numeric GPU/new-account verification and quota-review timing not established.

egress_ip_type.quote:
Priority support via private Slack channel and email
Service Level Agreement
IP Whitelisting
Static IPs
egress_ip_type.note: Teams-tier feature list offered 'Static IPs' as an add-on; lower tiers presumably use shared datacenter egress IPs. No numeric IP range/ASN documented; product discontinued 2025-10-31.

auto_stop_idle.quote: Idle apps are stopped After 4 hours without traffic ... Idle apps are removed After 48 hours without traffic
auto_stop_idle.note: True on the free Community tier; paid tiers (Professional/Teams/Enterprise) explicitly disabled this via 'Continuous app uptime (24/7)' / table showing 'No' for idle-stop on those tiers.

ingress_rules.quote:
Service Level Agreement
IP Whitelisting
Static IPs
ingress_rules.note: Teams tier offered IP Whitelisting (provider-side access control on exposed app URLs), plus password/Auth0/SSO app authentication gating on Professional/Teams/Enterprise.

sso.quote: App authentication with SSO, LDAP, or SAML ... Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, LDAP, or SAML
sso.note: Offered on the Enterprise plan (app authentication via SSO/SAML/LDAP/Entra ID), per the pricing comparison table.

max_session_h.note: Paid tiers ran apps continuously with no documented forced session cutoff; the only automatic stop was the idle timeout on the free Community tier (auto_stop_idle), not a hard session-length cap.

usage_api.quote: Ploomber's app hosting platform is shutting down
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; Platform discontinued 2025-10-31. Was a managed PaaS for Python apps with no documented per-sandbox/per-tag usage API. Only account-level billing via dashboard.
